annotations.title: Account-Less Google Gemini 4 Argon & 3.1 Pro Universal Text Generator

description: Generates text completions and structured reasoning across all 45 Google Gemini foundation models (Gemini 4 Argon, 3.1 Pro, 3.8 Flash) with zero Google account or API key required. Use when running single-turn reasoning, coding, or analytical prompts on a specific Gemini model; for delegating multi-step complex tasks that require remote tool execution, use execute_antigravity_agent instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'prompt' ('model' defaults to 'gemini-4-argon'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (50 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

model.description: Target Gemini foundation model identifier; defaults to 'gemini-4-argon' when omitted.

prompt.description: Primary user instruction or reasoning prompt to send to the selected Gemini model.

name: generate_gemini_completion

grounding_metadata.description: Optional citation metadata if search grounding was enabled.

model.description: Gemini model identifier that executed the completion.

success.description: True when inference completed without upstream errors.

title: Account-Less Google Gemini 4 Argon & 3.1 Pro Universal Text Generator
